title: "Dim" is too bright!
text:
"Dim" is too bright!. I already knew the noises on it would suck, but I sent my phone alarm to sound at the 7:15 so I wouldn't need to set sounds on the clock. At 6:45 the light pops on and wakes me up with a jolt because it's so bright. It's supposed to start really dim and gradually increase in brightness, right? I think it DOES get somewhat brighter by 7:15, but it's certainly not dim when it turns on at 6:45. I wanted a gentle, more natural wake up like I get in summer time, but nope! Don't go looking for that here. Facing me, facing the wall, facing wherever--it's still too bright when it first turns on. The gradual increase in light was the whole point of this thing. So much for that!

Not to mention using the buttons is a PITA. You have to press the alarm button repeatedly to either see what time you set the alarm for and/or set the alarm on or off. So I sit there and touch the button over and over again trying to get it to work for five minutes before I manage to turn it off or on.

I didn't try the little wire that you're supposed to use for a radio since we have no real clear radio stations in my town so I can't comment on that.

I don't use it anymore--I don't enjoy being jolted awake a full half hour before I'm supposed to get up. I'm pretty annoyed that I paid $20 for something I'll never end up using. I'll probably donate it for some other poor schmuck to deal with.

product_metadata.title: hOmeLabs Sunrise Alarm Clock - Digital LED Clock with 6 Color Switch and FM Radio for Bedrooms - Multiple Nature Sounds Sunset Simulation & Touch Control - with Snooze Function for Heavy Sleepers
features: Wake Up Sunrise Alarm Clock - This alarm clock uses a warm LED light that gradually brightens 30 mins before the alarm time to gently wake you up. Features a Sleep timer with sunset simulation to gently dim the room and can also act as a night light

Modern Alarm Clock for Heavy Sleepers - Gradually waking up to light with your choice of nature-inspired sounds is a pleasant way to start your day. Features an easy to hit snooze button to pause the alarm and turn off the light and sound for 5 mins

Decorative LED Color Options - With 8 colorful light options, this bedroom clock can double as table or bedside lamp during non-sleeping hours. Emitting vibrant colors like green, red, blue, purple or yellow it is perfect for a child’s alarm clock

Nature Sounds and FM Radio - Scroll through soothing nature-inspired sound options like birds, lullaby and ocean waves to wake you up. There’s also a throwback to the FM clock radio - just press radio button on clock top and touch (+) to set station

12-Hour and 24-Hour Digital Alarm Clock - Wide LED clock face touchscreen shows either a 12 or 24 hr time display and features 3 brightness settings depending on your liking. Alarm clock with USB charger and backup battery measures 3.9" x 6.8" x 7.2"
